title: Detect NPCs mentioned in a session
body:
Use AI to identify non-player characters mentioned or voiced during a session's transcript.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- NPCDetected event raised with the NPC's name and the transcript context it was found in
- Reasonable precision on a sample real/simulated session (manually reviewed)

title: Detect quests mentioned in a session
body:
Use AI to identify quest-related dialogue (new quests offered, progress, completion) within a session's transcript.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- QuestDetected event raised with a short description and the quest's apparent status
- Reasonable precision on a sample real/simulated session (manually reviewed)

title: Detect items mentioned in a session
body:
Use AI to identify notable items (weapons, artifacts, treasure) mentioned during a session.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Detected items are emitted as domain events with enough context to be organized later
- Reasonable precision on a sample real/simulated session (manually reviewed)

title: Detect locations mentioned in a session
body:
Use AI to identify places (cities, dungeons, regions) mentioned during a session.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Detected locations are emitted as domain events with enough context to be organized later
- Reasonable precision on a sample real/simulated session (manually reviewed)

title: Persist and organize detected NPCs
body:
Store detected NPCs in the campaign database, deduplicated and enriched across sessions rather than as one-off mentions.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- NPCs persist across sessions and accumulate context over time
- The same NPC mentioned in multiple sessions is recognized as one entity, not duplicated

title: Persist and organize detected quests
body:
Track quest lifecycle (offered, in progress, completed, abandoned) across sessions in the campaign database.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Quests persist across sessions with an evolving status
- Quest history is queryable per campaign

title: Persist and organize detected items and locations
body:
Store detected items and locations in the campaign database, associated with the sessions and NPCs they relate to.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Items and locations persist across sessions
- Both are queryable per campaign
